summaryDeep: Their action and your feelings cooperate. They move you and you aim them. Let them help you act on what you feel.
tension: The only real risk is letting this good rhythm go unused. Because it is easier than the harder Moon-Mars contacts, you may not track how much it helps. The support is there, but it still needs somewhere to go.
